Chapter 158: 0155 A 19th Birthday Present for Myself (

Chapter 158: 0155 A 19th Birthday Present for Myself (Bonus chapter for Alliance Leader echoaxiu)

The financing agreement signing ceremony and press conference were held on the second floor of the Peking University Science and Technology Building.

The main invitees were media from the Beijing area, as well as media outlets with reporters stationed in Beijing. Firstly, it saved time, and secondly, a travel stipend of a thousand yuan or so would suffice.

Of course, the mainstream financial media outlets were all invited, regardless of where their headquarters were located.

Today was a weekend.

The prettier girls from the Class of '04 Yuanpei Program had all received an invitation from Chen Guiliang—to be ceremonial hostesses.

Those willing to come would get a part-time salary and a small gift, and they would also be treated to a hearty lunch with good food and drinks.

Wu Meng from the Chinese Department came as well.

Ao Yanchen had also invited a few of her classmates to be hostesses.

"It's just up ahead, right?"

"Yeah, that tallest office building."

"Xiao Bian, you've got a great eye!"

The usually low-key Bian Guanyue really couldn't hold back last night and had told her roommates about her boyfriend's company receiving venture capital, her tone tinged with a bit of a brag.

She regretted it right after saying it, feeling she shouldn't be so vain.

Her roommates were incredibly envious, and after a series of compliments, Bian Guanyue asked for Chen Guiliang's opinion and agreed to bring her roommates to watch the excitement today.

Moreover, as long as they could make it in time, her roommates could also be hostesses. If there was nothing else to do, they could just stand to the side as living backdrops.

The six girls set out at the crack of dawn, rushing over from the Capital University of Economics and Business.

"Senior Ao!" Bian Guanyue called out.

Ao Yanchen smiled, "The boss's lady is here. For those who want to be hostesses, take them to the second floor to put on makeup and change."

"I want to be a hostess too," Bian Guanyue said.

Ao Yanchen was flabbergasted. "You aren't familiar with the procedures. Your main job will be to stand at certain spots and hand out information packets to the invited guests."

Bian Guanyue smiled, "It's fine, this is quite interesting."

After the six girls went upstairs, Ao Yanchen called Chen Guiliang. "Boss Chen, your girlfriend wants to be a hostess. I didn't force her, alright?"

"It's fine. Let her do whatever she wants," Chen Guiliang didn't stop her.

Chen Guiliang was currently in a conference room at the Innovation Center, accompanying the leaders from the Science Park Corporation and Incubator Corporation who had arrived early, along with Wang Kai.

The leaders were all beaming. ByteDance's latest round of financing was the most successful Peking University incubation project in the last two years.

The leaders even proactively helped out by inviting Founder and Jade Bird, which were about to move into the Peking University Science and Technology Building. The two companies gave the leaders face, agreeing to each send a vice president to attend as a guest.

Several established companies in the Science and Technology Building, as well as the incubated enterprises on the third and fourth floors, had also received invitations from Chen Guiliang.
